name: Analemma
description: The figure the sun traces over a year, drawn as a lopsided eight.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 22%; top: 4%; width: 52%; height: 52%; border-radius: 50%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 62%, #000 62%); mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 62%, #000 62%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 30%; top: 46%; width: 40%; height: 50%; border-radius: 50%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 58%, #000 58%); mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 58%, #000 58%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } -webkit-transform: scaleX(@pick(1, -1)); transform: scaleX(@pick(1, -1)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
